name: dartdeck
description: DartDeck - offline-first darts scoring, competition and training for Web/PWA and Android

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/store.js
scripts.android:add: npm run build:mobile && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.android:run: npm run build:mobile && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:add: npm run build:mobile && npx cap add ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
